items.title: Section: The Factors of Awakening Open — Seven Fields a Bodhisattva Must Master

items.zh: 如是一切皆因攝受無惱害福。最初發心堅固菩薩，由能攝受無惱害福，便得領受如是等類眾多勝利。如是菩薩既發心已。云何修行諸菩薩行？略說菩薩若所學處、若如是學、若能修學。如是一切總攝為一，名菩薩行。是諸菩薩於何處學？謂七處學。云何七處？嗢拕南曰：自、他利、實義、威力、熟有情、成熟自佛法、第七菩提處。一、自利處，二、利他處，三、真實義處，四、威力處，五、成熟有情處，六、成熟自佛法處，七、無上正等菩提處。云何自利利他處？
items.en: Having thus raised the resolve, how do bodhisattvas practice the conduct of a bodhisattva? In brief: what is to be trained in, how it is trained, and the actual carrying out of that training … in what does a bodhisattva train? Seven fields: the field of self-benefit; of benefiting others; of true meaning; of power; of ripening beings; of ripening one's own buddha-qualities; and of unsurpassed, perfect awakening.

items.zh: 謂自利利他略有十種。一、純自利利他，二、共自利利他，三、利益種類自利利他，四、安樂種類自利利他，五、因攝自利利他，六、果攝自利利他，七、此世自利利他，八、他世自利利他，九、畢竟自利利他，十、不畢竟自利利他。
items.en: Self-benefit and benefiting others are, in brief, of ten kinds: purely one or the other; both at once; belonging to the category of benefit; belonging to the category of happiness; included within cause; included within fruit; in this life; in another life; genuine and final; and not genuine or final.

items.zh: 云何菩薩純共自利利他？

items.title: What Looks Like Self-Benefit but Isn't — Five Warning Signs a Bodhisattva Must Recognise and Reject

items.zh: 謂諸菩薩，於純自利利他應知應斷，違越不順菩薩儀故。於其所餘應勤修學，不越隨順菩薩儀故。此中菩薩於純自利應知應斷者，謂為己樂，求財受用；或為悋法，於佛菩薩所說教法追訪受持。或為生天受天快樂，受持禁戒，發勤精進修習定慧；或求世間有染果報，為世財食，恭敬供養諸佛制多。或貪利養，為利養故，自說種種無有義利不實功德，誑惑於他，招集利養。
items.en: Bodhisattvas should recognise and reject purely self-directed conduct, since it violates and departs from the bodhisattva's own code … seeking wealth and enjoyment purely for one's own pleasure; or, out of stinginess with the teaching, seeking out and retaining the buddhas' and bodhisattvas' own teachings purely for oneself … keeping precepts merely to be reborn in a heaven and enjoy its pleasures … or, out of greed for material support, claiming various unreal, meaningless virtues for oneself, deceiving others in order to gather more offerings.

items.zh: 或欲貪他作己僮僕，為驅使故，非法攝眾，不如正法。矯設方便拔濟有情，令於他所免為僮僕，還自攝受為己僮僕；拔濟有情令脫繫縛，還自拘執成己事業；拔濟有情，令於他所解脫種種治罰怖畏，還自攝伏令懼於己。
items.en: Or, wishing to make others one's own servants for one's own use, gathering a following through improper rather than proper means; feigning a rescue to free someone from servitude elsewhere, only to take them into one's own service instead; rescuing someone from another's bondage, only to bind them to one's own agenda; or rescuing someone from another's punishment and fear, only to intimidate them into fearing oneself instead.

items.title: Pure Other-Benefit's Own Traps, and What Genuinely Counts as Helping Both at Once

items.zh: 若諸菩薩耽著諸定現法樂住，棄捨思惟利眾生事。當知此等名純自利。菩薩於是純自利行應知應斷。若諸菩薩或悲為首，或為迴向無上菩提，及為生天，於一切時修施、忍等，當知是名自利共他。又除如前所說諸相，其餘一切與彼相違所有自利諸
items.en: Should a bodhisattva become attached to the present bliss of meditative absorption, abandoning all thought of benefiting beings … [by contrast, a bodhisattva] already able to abide in dhyāna, out of the power of compassionate vow, relinquishes that very dhyāna and, as wished, returns to be reborn in the desire realm instead.

items.zh: 菩薩行，當知皆名自利共他。菩薩於此應勤修學。
此中菩薩於純利他應知應斷者，謂以邪見修行施等。以無因見及無果見，毀犯尸羅，遠離正行，為他說法。若諸菩薩於諸靜慮善巧迴轉，已超下地，而更攝受下地白法。謂彼已能安住靜慮，由悲願力捨諸靜慮，隨其所樂還生欲界。又諸菩薩已得自在，於十方界種種變化，作諸眾生種種義利。又諸牟尼自事已辦，依止如來力、無畏等所有一切不共佛法，遍於十方無量眾生，能作無量大利益事。
items.en: Among purely other-directed conduct, what a bodhisattva should recognise and reject: practising giving and the like under the influence of wrong view … or, holding views that deny cause and effect, breaking precepts and abandoning correct conduct while still teaching others … [by contrast, to be cultivated:] a bodhisattva skilled in the dhyānas, having already transcended the lower realm, deliberately takes up its wholesome qualities once more; a bodhisattva already master of miraculous transformation, benefiting beings throughout the ten directions in whatever form serves them; and buddhas themselves, their own task complete, benefiting boundless beings through the powers, fearlessnesses, and every quality unique to a buddha.

items.zh: 當知此等名純利他。如是所說純利他行，菩薩於前所說二種應知應斷。於餘所說純利他行，多應修學。又除如前所說諸相，其餘一切與彼相違所有利他諸菩薩行，當知皆名利他共自。菩薩於此應勤修學。云何菩薩利益種類自利利他？

blocks.text: Having raised the resolve, how does a bodhisattva practise? The treatise first lists seven fields of training, then distinguishes true from false self-benefit and benefit for others. A short passage (0483a21) is untranslated.

What is trained in, how, and who trains. The fields: self-benefit; benefiting others; the true meaning (reality); power; ripening beings; ripening one's own Buddha qualities; and unsurpassed awakening. Venerable Miào Jìng: a bodhisattva cannot purely benefit himself.
Benefit to self or others may be: purely one, both; in the category of benefit or happiness; as cause or as fruit; in this life or another; genuine and final, or not.

"Seeking wealth and pleasure purely for oneself"; "out of stinginess with the teaching, seeking out profound texts only for oneself"; "wishing to make others one's servants"; "feigning a rescue to free someone from servitude elsewhere, only to take them into one's own service". These look like self-benefit but violate the bodhisattva's code.

"Attached to the present bliss of absorption, abandoning all thought of beings" is to be rejected; a true bodhisattva "already able to abide in absorption, out of compassionate vow relinquishes it" to be reborn among beings. And "practising giving under wrong view", or "denying cause and effect, breaking precepts", even in the name of helping others, is to be rejected. Master Cháng Bǎi gives examples.

quiz.q: "What is trained in, how it is trained, and carrying out the training." How does Master Cháng Bǎi distinguish them?
options: the Dharma to learn; what to practise; diligently carrying it out
quiz.why: "In brief: what is to be trained in, how it is trained, and the actual carrying out of that training." Master Cháng Bǎi: the Dharma one should learn is "what is trained in"; what one should practise is "how it is trained"; diligently putting it into practice is "carrying out the training."

quiz.q: The first of the seven fields is "self-benefit." Why must a bodhisattva benefit self, per Venerable Miào Jìng?
options: one can't only benefit beings — one must also study the noble path oneself
quiz.why: "The field of self-benefit; of benefiting others." Venerable Miào Jìng: a bodhisattva can't purely benefit beings; one must study the noble path oneself — hence "the field of self-benefit."

quiz.q: Pure self-benefit "violates the bodhisattva's code." What is the code, per Master Cháng Bǎi?
options: the three pure precepts — restraint, gathering good, benefiting beings
quiz.why: "Bodhisattvas should recognise and reject purely self-directed conduct, since it violates and departs from the bodhisattva's own code." Master Cháng Bǎi: the three pure precepts a bodhisattva takes — restraint, gathering wholesome qualities, and benefiting beings — are called the bodhisattva code.

quiz.q: "Feigning a rescue from servitude elsewhere, only to take them into one's own service." How does Venerable Miào Jìng put it?
quiz.why: "Feigning a rescue to free someone from servitude elsewhere, only to take them into one's own service instead." Venerable Miào Jìng: it means poaching them.

quiz.q: Pure other-benefit to reject: "practising giving under wrong view." The note reads it as secretly denying cause and effect. What do the lectures say?
options: Cháng Bǎi: clinging to merit-making as supreme while neglecting wisdom and concentration; Miào Jìng: the treatise doesn't define wrong view here
quiz.why: "Practising giving and the like under the influence of wrong view." Master Cháng Bǎi: e.g., clinging to giving, precepts, and the immeasurables as supreme merit-making, while not wanting to do the profound wisdom, concentration, and diligence. Venerable Miào Jìng: what is wrong view? The Yogācārabhūmi doesn't say here. Denying cause and effect is the next item; the note merges the two.

quiz.q: Abiding in dhyāna, "by compassionate vow relinquishing it and returning to the desire realm." How, per Venerable Miào Jìng?
options: skilfully stirring a little desire, so one isn't reborn in the form realm but returns to the desire realm
quiz.why: "Already able to abide in dhyāna, out of the power of compassionate vow, relinquishes that very dhyāna and, as wished, returns to be reborn in the desire realm instead." Venerable Miào Jìng: skilfully stirring a little desire, one isn't born in a form-realm heaven but comes back to the desire realm.
